items.summary: 记者从水利部了解到，受超强厄尔尼诺影响，当前和今后一个时期，水旱灾害防御面临的气候条件将极为不利。目前，黄河上游内蒙古河段已出现首凌，预计12月上中旬出现首封，都较常年同期偏晚。气温波动变化更容易形成冰塞、冰坝，增加黄河凌汛风险。初步研判，长江流域、太湖流域、松花江流域也存在发生流域性洪水的风险，其他流域也会发生不同程度的洪水。水利部动态滚动研判，强化对极端性洪水、干旱、旱涝急转等的防范应对。

items.title: Arteta sets Arsenal 100-point Premier League target to emulate Manchester City
items.summary: ‘It’s only been done once and that’s what we want’Arteta not being drawn on City’s financial chargesMikel Arteta has set Arsenal the ­target of emulating Manchester City by becoming only the second team in Premier League history to record 100 points in a season.Arteta was an assistant for Pep Guardiola’s side when they achieved the landmark in the 2017-18 campaign, beating second-placed Manchester United by 19 points. City head to the Emirates Stadium on Sunday already trailing Arsenal by six points after just 11 games, with Enzo Maresca’s side having failed to win any of their four previous league matches. items.title: Spygate tensions erupt at Southampton after Finn Azaz’s cry-baby celebration riles Boro
items.summary: When asked whether he had any regrets about running the length of the pitch to goad the Middlesbrough supporters he used to call his own with a mock crying celebration, Finn Azaz was unequivocal. “None whatsoever,” said the Southampton playmaker. And you get the sense that very few associated with his club disagreed.Southampton, and their manager Tonda Eckert, long ago admitted their Spygate crime. Based on the behaviour of many connected to the south-coast club – their manager a notable exception – they have embraced it. The sense of aggrievement that it cost them the chance of promotion last season remains. Continue reading...

items.title: Gibbs-White and Igor Jesus fire Nottingham Forest past shaky Chelsea
items.summary: Wesley Fofana, as a former Leicester player, might have expected the celebrating Nottingham Forest fans to give him a hard time. But, at the end of a week in which he invited opprobrium by making light of missing a penalty at Liverpool in an unsanctioned French interview, he endured the ultimate ignominy when Chelsea supporters followed a four-letter suggestion to tell the defender: “You’re not welcome here.”Fofana was humiliated by Liam Delap before fouling the former Chelsea striker for a penalty that Morgan Gibbs-White converted for the first of his two goals. The result, coming after Forest’s win against Manchester City in their last match at the City Ground, means they climb three points clear of the Premier League’s relegation zone. Continue reading...

items.title: The explosion of extreme wealth is the major problem of our time | Bernie Sanders
items.summary: At this pivotal moment in American history, let us move forward together to take on and defeat a powerful, greedy and corrupt ruling classWe are at a pivotal moment in history. Never before in human history have so few people held so much wealth and so much power. And never before have we seen such an unprecedented level of greed, arrogance and irresponsibility on the part of the world’s ruling class.Here is the good news: leaders from around the world are finally starting to wake up. This week, elected officials and economists from around the world – including four Nobel prize winners – came together in Paris for a “Summit Against International Oligarchy”. As the summit’s proclamation stated, “The explosion of extreme wealth is the major social fact of our time … We are sounding the alarm: billionaires are a threat to our democracies.”Bernie Sanders is a US senator, and ranking member of the health, education, labor and pensions committee. He represents the state of Vermont and is the longest-serving independent in the history of Congress Continue reading...

items.title: Why have things started to go wrong for Manchester City under Enzo Maresca?
items.summary: A sensational start for the Italian was swiftly followed by a dismal run and long faces in the teamThis is the great known unknown in Manchester City’s run of one win – in addition to victory on penalties against Brighton in the Carabao Cup – in seven matches. After guilty verdicts were returned regarding the breaking of Premier League financial rules, Enzo Maresca’s team went to Anfield and handed Liverpool a 3-0 schooling. Yet this proved the falsest of dawns, with Andoni Iraola’s nascent side perhaps caught in a bad moment. City have since managed one league victory (3-2 over Ipswich, six days later) and two more wins in regulation time (in the Champions League) in 10 matches. The sequence includes one point from the past four league fixtures. Maresca argues that his, too, is an embryonic project so there will be uneven form. “I am not a magician,” he said on Friday. But it is also fair to ponder whether, after the adrenaline surge of an us-against-the-world mentality carried City to the Liverpool and Ipswich wins, the grim reality of what the guilty verdict may mean for careers is affecting players. City have appealed against the ruling, saying they are “innocent of the accusations”. Continue reading...

items.title: The Com: the global cybercrime network posing a ‘chilling threat’ to children
items.summary: FBI estimates thousands of people identify as members, or recent members, of group linked to indecent images of girls and blackmailIt sounds benign: the Com, short for the Community. But crime agencies around the world warn that it is far from that and the young cybercriminals involved are causing havoc and putting children at chilling, sickening risk.Beau-Jack Mensforth was jailed by a UK judge on Friday for his activities as part of the Com. He was one individual operating from his bedroom in north-east England, but there are probably thousands more like him and parents are being urged by police to be aware and to check their children’s devices. items.title: The best cordless vacuum cleaners for a spotless home: 10 tried and tested favourites
items.summary: Stick vacuums are a convenient alternative to corded designs, but which model wins for overall cleaning prowess? Our expert reveals all• The best robot vacuums• How to make your vacuum last longerChoosing a cordless vacuum is a big decision. Whichever model you go for, you’re likely to use it for years, relying on its ability to suck up dust, crumbs, mud, pet hair and any other dry spillages or sheddings. Choosing the right model can be the difference between an effective cleaner that’s a delight to pull out of the cupboard and a dud that you dread having to unblock, detangle and clean after every use.In this review, I took 18 of the leading cordless vacuum cleaners from a range of manufacturers and at various prices and inflicted the same cleaning tests on each one. That takes all the guesswork out of picking your next cleaner: I can tell you exactly which ones picked up the most mess, and how easy and enjoyable they were to use. Continue reading...
